identity.fantasy: An angelic block tank who scales with Intellect, swings Dawnbreak and Gavels, casts instant Illumination, and protects the party from magical damage.
identity.one_line: Build Intellect-scaled block through Dawnbreak and Gavels, use instant Illumination, and time Solar Invocation for magic danger.

mechanics.core_loop: An Intellect and block-value tank using Dawnbreak, Gavels, Angelic Presence, instant Illumination, and Solar Invocation. It combines active tanking with meaningful party healing and a major group magic-damage cooldown.
mechanics.single_target: On durable targets, the structural path grows from Dawnbreak, Angelic Presence, The Chosen toward Adjudicator, Scroll of Hope, Sun Strider. A precise priority remains limited to the captured build and community evidence.
mechanics.aoe: For multiple targets, Build Intellect-scaled block through Dawnbreak and Gavels, use instant Illumination, and time Solar Invocation for magic danger. The current evidence particularly constrains this through: A Stockades leveler reports fragility; replies note many tanks lack tools before 25 to 30.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Melee tank positioning combines with party-aware support targeting.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Dawnbreak, The Chosen, Shining Shield, Seraphic Bulwark, Sun-Touched Armor.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Divine Right, Blessed One, Solar Nova, Calm, Judgement.

failure_modes.text: Using instant Illumination or Solar Invocation for routine damage can leave the party without its needed recovery or magic answer.
